import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; import { dashboardAPI } from '../services/api'; import ImageWithFallback from '../components/ImageWithFallback'; const ProfilePage = () => { const { user, balance } = useAuth(); const [stats, setStats] = useState({ casesOpened: 0, upgradesPerformed: 0, successRate: 0, inventoryValue: 0, bestDrop: 'None' }); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); useEffect(() => { const fetchProfileData = async () => { try { // Get user stats from dashboard API const statsResponse = await dashboardAPI.getHistory(); // Using history to calculate stats const history = statsResponse.data; // Calculate stats const casesOpened = history.filter(item => item.type === 'opening').length; const upgradesPerformed = history.filter(item => item.type === 'upgrade').length; const totalActions = casesOpened + upgradesPerformed; const successRate = totalActions > 0 ? Math.round((casesOpened / totalActions) * 100) : 0; // For demo purposes, we'll set some values setStats({ casesOpened, upgradesPerformed, successRate, inventoryValue: 0, // Would calculate from inventory in real app bestDrop: 'AK-47 | Redline (Field-Tested)' // Would find from history }); } catch (error) { console.error('Error fetching profile data:', error); } finally { setLoading(false); } }; fetchProfileData(); }, [user]); if (loading) { return (
